answer: A proof-of-burn protocol deters Sybils by requiring agents to permanently destroy tokens to maintain membership. An attacker incurs an unrecoverable capital cost per identity, preventing the recycling of deposits across phantom nodes. Each validated state delta updates a decentralized agent atlas, leaving expired burn receipts as an inert relic of compliance. However, this ongoing tax penalizes resource-constrained honest agents and fails against adversaries with deep capital reserves.
